body.en: When using the command line on a Mac, pressing key combinations such as `alt+m` often led to no response or typed unexpected special characters. The default behavior for Option-key combinations on macOS has been updated. Previously, when pressing Option-key shortcuts in your terminal without configuring Option to act as Alt beforehand, pressing them did nothing or directly typed special characters such as `µ`; now these shortcuts work right out of the box without manually changing terminal preferences. ⟦Picture plugging in a newly bought gaming keyboard: previously, you had to reconfigure key mappings yourself before special function keys worked, but now connecting it to the computer immediately recognizes default shortcuts.⟧ If you still prefer the original input behavior, setting the environment variable `AGY_CLI_MAC_OPTION_AS_ALT=0` will return to the old behavior, keeping your terminal's previous key mapping rules.

items.original: Changed the default for macOS Option-key shortcuts such as `alt+m`, which now work out of the box without setting Option to act as Alt in your terminal, where previously pressing them did nothing or typed a character such as `µ`; set `AGY_CLI_MAC_OPTION_AS_ALT=0` to go back to the old behavior.

title.zh-TW: 跳過權限模式增設安全防線，保護高風險指令並排除子代理停頓
title.en: Permission-skipping mode adds safety guardrails, protecting high-risk commands and resolving subagent stalls

body.zh-TW: 當你啟用 `--dangerously-skip-permissions` 參數跑自動化任務時，高風險操作與工作區邊界有了更清楚的防線。⟦類似拿著快速通行證進出廠區，以前只要出示證件就能進入所有庫房；現在特定管制區與管理規定仍需查驗，但一般走道上的隨行助理不再被警衛無端攔下盤查。⟧該模式不再自動放行內建清單中的受保護指令，這些指令會恢復一般審核，其餘指令仍照常免詢問執行。若企業管理員要求工作區外的指令或檔案存取必須經過審查，`--dangerously-skip-permissions` 與設為自動放行的外掛代理都不會跳過；無頭模式（headless，沒有終端機視覺介面的執行模式）則會直接拒絕此類請求。子代理在此模式下存取工作區外檔案時，先前會卡頓約 60 秒、卡在檔案權限上，現在讀寫均可直接通行，搭配 `-p` 也不再停頓，自訂的明確拒絕規則仍維持有效。
body.en: When you enable `--dangerously-skip-permissions` to run automated tasks, high-risk operations and workspace boundaries have clearer guardrails. ⟦Think of how a fast pass works in a factory facility: previously, flashing your badge opened every storeroom, but now restricted zones and governance policies still require verification while accompanying assistants in common corridors are no longer needlessly stopped by guards.⟧ The mode no longer automatically approves commands on the built-in protected list, which now return to normal review, while other commands continue to run without asking. If enterprise administrators require commands or file access outside the workspace to be reviewed, neither `--dangerously-skip-permissions` nor plugin agents set to auto-allow will bypass those checks. In addition, headless mode (running without a terminal visual interface) now directly denies such requests. When subagents accessed files outside the workspace in this mode, they previously stalled for about 60 seconds on file permissions; both reads and writes now proceed directly without prompting, runs with `-p` no longer pause, and custom explicit deny rules remain in effect.

items.original:
Changed `--dangerously-skip-permissions` so commands on the built-in list of protected commands are no longer approved automatically and go through the usual checks, while every other command still runs without asking.
Changed `--dangerously-skip-permissions` and plugin agents set to auto-allow so they no longer approve terminal commands or file access outside the workspace when your Gemini Enterprise administrator requires those to be reviewed, and headless runs now deny such requests instead.
Fixed subagents stalling for about 60 seconds on file permissions under `--dangerously-skip-permissions`, so reads and writes outside the workspace now go through without a prompt, and headless `-p` runs with the flag no longer wait on any remaining interaction, while your explicit deny rules still apply.

title.zh-TW: 存取工作區外的檔案改為單一授權，不再一次開放全部目錄
title.en: File access outside the workspace switches to single-path authorization, ending broad directory exposure

body.zh-TW: 碰到代理需要讀取工作區外部的特定設定檔時，提示視窗不再要求你交出整個外部目錄的控制權。代理請求存取工作區外的檔案時，確認提示會明確顯示 `Allow access to this file?`。你可以針對當前指定的單一路徑，選擇在本次對話中永遠允許或拒絕，或將設定直接寫進 `settings.json`；系統不會再因為單一檔案的請求，就一口氣開放工作區外所有檔案的存取權限。⟦好比向大樓管理員借鑰匙，以前只要借用單一辦公室，就得把整棟大樓的門禁全面解鎖；現在管理員只會精準發放你指名那間會議室的感應卡，離開後其餘房間依然安全上鎖。⟧這讓你在引用公用設定或全域工具時，既能放心放行特定文件，又不必擔心整個硬碟門戶大開。
body.en: When an agent needs to read a specific configuration file outside the workspace, the prompt window no longer asks you to surrender control over the entire external directory. When an agent requests access to a file outside the workspace, the confirmation prompt clearly displays `Allow access to this file?`. You can choose to always allow or deny that single path for the current conversation, or write the setting directly into `settings.json`; the system will no longer open access to all files outside the workspace just because of a single file request. ⟦Consider borrowing keys from a building manager: whereas requesting a single office once required opening up access across the entire building, the manager now issues a keycard solely for your designated conference room, leaving all other rooms securely locked.⟧ When referencing shared configurations or global tools, this lets you confidently approve specific documents without worrying about leaving your entire hard drive wide open.

items.original: Changed the prompt shown when the agent asks for access to a file outside the workspace, which now reads `Allow access to this file?` and offers to always allow or deny that one path for the conversation or in `settings.json`, instead of turning on access to everything outside the workspace.

title.zh-TW: 修復指令選單與多任務循環錯誤，並強化遠端連線重試機制
title.en: Fixed command menus and queued message retry loops, and strengthened remote connection retries

body.zh-TW:
日常切換各類執行模式與操控通道時，幾處影響操作流暢度的小毛病現在都已獲得改善。

使用 `agy -p` 執行單次輸出時，不再於背景發送模型請求來生成終端機根本不會顯示的對話標題，省下多餘的模型等待與消耗。

建立遠端控制連線時，若在建立初期遇上短暫的網路波動或伺服器抖動，會主動重新嘗試連線，不再直接中斷離開。

代理執行出錯當下若剛好有排隊中的訊息，先前會陷入連續瘋狂重試的迴圈，現在這些排隊訊息會暫停並等待你的下一道指令。

在 `agy acp` 工作階段中，斜線選單修正為列出當前工作階段代理的指令與技能，自訂代理的專屬工具也能正常顯示，不再誤列預設代理的選項。

以前在這些情境下容易遇到連線驟斷或無效重試，現在各類執行模式都能穩定收尾。
body.en:
Several small issues that affected operational smoothness when switching across execution modes and control channels have now been resolved.

Running single outputs with `agy -p` no longer makes a background model request to generate a conversation title that the terminal never shows, saving redundant model waits and resource usage.

When establishing Remote Control connections, encountering brief network fluctuations or server jitter during initial setup now triggers automatic retries instead of immediately dropping the connection.

If messages were queued at the moment the agent encountered an error, the agent previously entered a rapid retry loop, but those queued messages now pause and wait for your next command.

In `agy acp` sessions, the `/` menu has been corrected to list the commands and skills of the agent running the session, properly displaying custom agents' dedicated tools instead of mistakenly listing the default agent's options.

Where sudden disconnections or futile retry loops once occurred in these scenarios, various execution modes now conclude cleanly and reliably.

items.original:
Improved `agy -p` runs so they no longer make a background model request to generate a conversation title that print mode never shows.
Improved Remote Control connections, which now retry a brief network or server error while setting up a new connection instead of dropping it.
Fixed the agent re-running a failed turn in a rapid loop when messages were queued at the moment it hit an error, so queued messages now wait for your next message.
Fixed the `/` menu listing the commands and skills of a default agent instead of those of the agent the session actually runs, so in `agy acp` sessions it now shows that session's agent, including a custom agent's commands.

title.zh-TW: 擴充套件防範惡意路徑穿越，阻擋符號連結並放寬欄位驗證
title.en: Plugins guard against malicious path traversal, blocking symbolic links and relaxing field validation

body.zh-TW: 從外部下載社群擴充套件或開啟陌生的專案儲存庫時，外掛的檔案操作與載入範圍受到更嚴密的防護。⟦如同租借公共置物櫃，以前可能藉由暗道打通鄰近隔間；現在置物櫃加裝防護鋼板，嚴禁穿透到其他櫃位，標籤格式不符也只會貼上警告而非直接退件。⟧`agy plugin` 的各項指令會拒絕不安全的套件名稱並回報 `invalid plugin name`，且禁止寫入套件資料夾外或透過符號連結（symlink，指向另一個位置的捷徑檔）寫入，防止惡意套件覆寫 `mcp_config.json` 等設定檔。工作區內的 `.agents/plugins.json` 與 `.agents/skills.json` 限制僅能從工作區或儲存庫內部載入，以絕對路徑、`../` 或捷徑指向外部的項目一律略過。而 `agy plugin validate` 遇到未知欄位時改為發出警告並略過，其餘擴充設定照常檢查。
body.en: When downloading community plugins from external sources or opening unfamiliar repositories, plugin file operations and loading boundaries are now more tightly protected. ⟦Public storage lockers provide a useful parallel: where hidden passages might once have broken through adjacent compartments, lockers now feature steel reinforcement plates that strictly prevent breaches into neighboring units, while nonconforming label formats merely receive a warning rather than outright rejection.⟧ Commands under `agy plugin` reject unsafe plugin names with `invalid plugin name`, and refuse to write outside the plugins folder or through symbolic links (shortcut files pointing to another location), preventing malicious plugins from overwriting configuration files such as `mcp_config.json`. Items listed in a workspace's `.agents/plugins.json` or `.agents/skills.json` are restricted to load only from within the workspace or repository root, and entries pointing externally via absolute paths, `../`, or shortcuts are skipped. In addition, when `agy plugin validate` encounters unknown fields, it now emits a warning and skips them while checking remaining extension settings normally.

items.original:
Improved `agy plugin validate` so an unknown field under `extensions["com.google.antigravity"]` in `plugin.json` is reported as a warning that the field is ignored instead of an error, and the plugin's other extension settings are still checked.
Improved protection against malicious plugins: `agy plugin` import, install, uninstall, enable, and disable now reject plugin names that are not safe file names with `invalid plugin name`, and refuse to write outside the plugins folder or through symbolic links, so an imported plugin can no longer overwrite other configuration files such as `mcp_config.json`.
Improved protection against untrusted repositories: plugins and skills listed in a workspace's `.agents/plugins.json` or `.agents/skills.json` now load only from inside the workspace or its repository root, and entries that point elsewhere through absolute paths, `../`, or symbolic links are skipped.

title.zh-TW: MCP 協定修復 OAuth 重新連線錯誤，並完整傳遞工具自訂參數
title.en: MCP protocol fixes OAuth reconnection errors and delivers custom tool parameters intact

body.zh-TW: 透過 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）連接伺服器並使用 OAuth 登入時，授權流程與工具溝通現在更加可靠。⟦宛如在線上商城完成多步驟結帳，以前只要分頁在中途重新整理，先前建立的付款金鑰就會失效；現在重整後仍能沿用原本的交易憑證，填寫的寄送備註也能完整送達系統。⟧過去登入採用 OAuth 的 MCP 伺服器時，若因 `/mcp` 重新載入或開啟新對話而重新連線，常會跳出 `Invalid PKCE code_verifier` 錯誤；現在原本打開的登入連結依然有效。若 MCP 工具宣告了 `explanation`、`toolSummary`、`toolAction` 或 `waitForPreviousTools` 參數，先前呼叫常漏傳這些引數，現在模型發送的數值都能確實送達工具。
body.en: When connecting to servers via MCP (Model Context Protocol, an open standard connecting AI models to external tools) and signing in with OAuth, authorization workflows and tool communications are now significantly more reliable. ⟦Imagine completing a multi-step checkout at an online storefront: previously, refreshing the tab midway invalidated the established payment key; now the original transaction credentials remain valid after a refresh, and custom shipping notes reliably reach the system.⟧ When signing in to an MCP server that uses OAuth, if a reconnection occurred due to `/mcp` reloading servers or starting a new turn, an `Invalid PKCE code_verifier` error previously appeared; now the originally opened sign-in link remains valid. Furthermore, if an MCP tool declared its own `explanation`, `toolSummary`, `toolAction`, or `waitForPreviousTools` parameters, calls previously omitted these arguments, but values sent by the model now reach the tool intact.

items.original:
Fixed signing in to an MCP server that uses OAuth failing with `Invalid PKCE code_verifier` when the server reconnected during sign-in, such as when `/mcp` reloaded servers or a new turn started, so the sign-in link you already opened keeps working.
Fixed MCP tools that declare their own `explanation`, `toolSummary`, `toolAction`, or `waitForPreviousTools` parameter receiving calls without that argument, so the value the model sends now reaches the tool.

title.zh-TW: 修復中日語音輸入字元間距，全形英文字詞空格不再遺失
title.en: Fixed Chinese and Japanese voice dictation character spacing, preserving spaces between fullwidth Latin words

body.zh-TW: 使用中文或日文進行語音輸入時，即時聽寫草稿的字元間隔現在顯示得更加自然。以前在最終辨識結果送達前，中文與日文的即時草稿會在每個字元之間硬塞一個空格，而全形英文字詞彼此之間的正常空格反而會無故消失。這個問題已經修復，現在草稿能維持連續排版，全形英文字詞間的空格也能正確保留。
body.en: When using voice dictation in Chinese or Japanese, character spacing in live dictation drafts now appears much more natural. Previously, before the final transcript arrived, live drafts in Chinese and Japanese inserted an unwanted space between every character, while normal spaces between fullwidth Latin words vanished without cause. This issue has been resolved: drafts now maintain continuous typography, and spaces between fullwidth Latin words are correctly preserved.

items.original: Fixed voice dictation in Chinese and Japanese showing a space between every character in the live draft before the final transcript arrived, and fullwidth Latin words losing the spaces between them.

entries: Changed `agy acp` to offer every model available to your account to every ACP client, where previously only a fixed list of editors were offered models other than Gemini.

Changed the tabs in `/config` during `--remote-agent` sessions from `Local` and `Remote` to `TUI` and `Remote Agent`, so it is clear that one configures the terminal UI and the other the remote agent; the settings on each tab are unchanged.

Improved how quickly the agent moves on after a terminal command exits while a background process it started still holds the command's output open, which now takes at most about 1 second instead of 5.
Improved subagent rows above the prompt so a subagent that is blocked waiting on you names the tool it is waiting on, such as `Blocked · AskQuestion`, instead of `Blocked · Processing...`.

Improved how plugin OAuth credentials are protected in the terminal sandbox: a plugin's real token now replaces its stand-in only in a request's `Authorization` header, so a command can no longer get a website to echo the real token back by sending the stand-in in another header or in the URL.

Fixed several `agy acp` session bugs: closing, reloading, or resuming a session while a prompt runs now ends that prompt as `cancelled` instead of leaving it hanging, cancelling a prompt no longer also stops the next prompt sent right after it, `session/update` notifications no longer arrive after the `session/prompt` reply for that prompt, and permission requests and question forms now close when they are answered elsewhere or their prompt ends, instead of blocking later prompts or receiving their answers.

Fixed file edits on Windows failing with `target content not found` in files that use CRLF line endings, so edits now match whichever line endings the file uses and the lines they insert keep the file's line endings.

Fixed agent-run commands on Windows failing or returning garbled text when their output contains non-ASCII characters, by running Python in UTF-8 mode (`PYTHONUTF8=1`, unless you have set `PYTHONUTF8` yourself) and switching PowerShell's output encoding to UTF-8.
Fixed stdio MCP servers on Windows leaving their child processes running after the server stops, which could lock plugin folders and make plugin upgrades fail because the files were in use.
Fixed `agy plugin` commands being unavailable, with no plugin marketplaces listed, when you sign in with Application Default Credentials (`AGY_ADC_AUTH`) or through an enterprise model gateway.
Fixed the built-in `browser` agent being listed among the agents you can start a conversation with, since it is meant to run only as a subagent, which it still does.
Fixed copy-on-select and `/copy` inside GNU screen, so copied text now reaches your clipboard and long selections no longer leave stray characters in the terminal.

title.zh-TW: agy acp 開放帳號所有可用模型，支援任何 ACP 客戶端
title.en: agy acp Opens All Account Models to Any ACP Client

body.zh-TW: 在偏好的程式碼編輯器中透過 `agy acp` 串接模型時，挑選清單不再受工具種類限制。⟦如同走進連鎖咖啡廳，以前只有旗艦店的機台能點選特調飲品，其他分店只能選基本美式；現在只要登入同一個會員帳號，每台點餐螢幕都會列出帳號可選的所有品項。⟧過去只有少數列在固定名單上的編輯器，才能挑選 Gemini 以外的模型，其他串接的用戶端都無法選用。現在這項限制已經移除。只要是你帳號有權限使用的模型，`agy acp` 都會完整提供給每一個連接的 ACP 客戶端。
body.en: When connecting models through `agy acp` in your preferred code editor, the selection list is no longer limited by the type of tool. ⟦Picture walking into a chain coffee shop: previously, only ordering kiosks at flagship locations let you select specialty drinks, while other branches offered only a basic Americano; now, as long as you log into the same membership account, every ordering screen lists all items available to that account.⟧ In the past, only a small number of editors on a fixed list could choose models other than Gemini, while other connected clients could not use them. This restriction has now been removed. As long as a model is available to your account, `agy acp` provides it completely to every connected ACP client.

items.original: Changed `agy acp` to offer every model available to your account to every ACP client, where previously only a fixed list of editors were offered models other than Gemini.

title.zh-TW: 遠端代理模式的分頁標籤重新命名，清楚區分介面與遠端設定
title.en: Tabs in Remote Agent Mode Renamed to Clearly Distinguish UI and Agent Settings

body.zh-TW: 只要加上 `--remote-agent` 參數開啟遠端工作階段，並輸入 `/config` 調整選項，畫面上方的分頁名稱便有了更精確的標記。⟦好比音響擴大機上的旋鈕標籤，以前只印著「本機」與「遠端」，讓人摸不清到底在調螢幕還是外接喇叭；現在直接改印「顯示面板」與「外接音箱」，看字面就知道在調整哪一部份。⟧以往這類工作階段裡的設定分頁標為 `Local` 與 `Remote`，容易讓人混淆各自掌管的範圍。現在分頁正式改為 `TUI` 與 `Remote Agent`，清楚表明一邊用來設定終端機介面，另一邊專門調整遠端代理。兩個分頁底下的所有設定項目本身都維持不變。
body.en: Whenever you start a remote session with the `--remote-agent` flag and enter `/config` to adjust options, the tab names at the top of the screen have more precise labels. ⟦Think of knob labels on an audio amplifier: previously, they were only printed with "Local" and "Remote," leaving you unsure whether you were tuning the screen or external speakers; now they are printed as "Display Panel" and "External Speakers," making it clear from the text alone which part is being adjusted.⟧ Previously, the configuration tabs in these sessions were labeled `Local` and `Remote`, making it easy to confuse the scope governed by each. The tabs are now officially changed to `TUI` and `Remote Agent`, making it clear that one configures the terminal interface and the other specifically adjusts the remote agent. All settings under both tabs remain unchanged.

items.original: Changed the tabs in `/config` during `--remote-agent` sessions from `Local` and `Remote` to `TUI` and `Remote Agent`, so it is clear that one configures the terminal UI and the other the remote agent; the settings on each tab are unchanged.

title.zh-TW: 終端指令退出後縮短等待，背景程序佔用時 1 秒內接續
title.en: Reduced Wait After Terminal Command Exits, Resuming Within 1 Second When Background Processes Hold Output

body.zh-TW: 請代理在終端機執行指令時，若指令啟動了持續在背景運作的程序，對話流程切換得更即時。⟦跟交響樂團的樂章銜接一樣，以前指揮剛放下指揮棒，只要後方定音鼓的餘音還沒徹底消散，整個樂團就要在台上乾等；現在只要主要樂器停奏，指揮便能立刻帶領大家進入下一段旋律。⟧以前終端機指令雖然已經執行完畢退出，但只要它衍生的背景程序仍佔用著輸出通道，代理會原地等待 5 秒才繼續往下走。現在這項等待已縮短至至多約 1 秒，讓代理能迅速接續執行後續任務。
body.en: When asking the agent to run commands in the terminal, if a command launches a process that continues running in the background, the conversation switches more promptly. ⟦Like the transition between movements in a symphony orchestra: previously, as soon as the conductor lowered the baton, if the reverberation of the timpani in the back had not completely died down, the entire orchestra had to wait idly on stage; now, as soon as the main instruments stop playing, the conductor can immediately lead everyone into the next melody.⟧ Previously, even though a terminal command had finished executing and exited, as long as a background process it spawned still held the output channel open, the agent would wait in place for 5 seconds before moving forward. This wait has now been shortened to at most about 1 second, allowing the agent to swiftly move on to subsequent tasks.

items.original: Improved how quickly the agent moves on after a terminal command exits while a background process it started still holds the command's output open, which now takes at most about 1 second instead of 5.

title.zh-TW: 子代理等待回應時標明工具名稱，精確掌握卡住原因
title.en: Subagents Waiting for Input Name Tool Directly to Pinpoint Causes of Pauses

body.zh-TW: 委派子代理執行任務的多工過程中，輸入框上方的狀態提示能直接看出它需要你做什麼。⟦就像診所診間外的叫號燈，以前只亮著含糊的「處理中」，病患在門外完全不知道該不該進去；現在燈號會直接改亮「等待驗光」，大家一看就知道接下來要配合哪個檢查項目。⟧以往在輸入框上方的子代理狀態列中，如果子代理卡住並等待你的輸入，狀態只會籠統顯示為 `Blocked · Processing...`，讓人無法判斷它究竟是在運算還是等候回應。現在狀態會直接列出卡住它的工具名稱，例如顯示為 `Blocked · AskQuestion`，清楚指出它正等著你回答問題。
body.en: During multitasking where subagents are delegated tasks, the status prompt above the input box directly reveals what it needs from you. ⟦Consider a call light outside a clinic exam room: previously, it only lit up with a vague "Processing," leaving patients outside unsure whether to enter; now the indicator directly switches to "Waiting for Optometry," so everyone knows at a glance which examination item to follow.⟧ Previously, in the subagent status row above the prompt, if a subagent was blocked waiting on your input, the status only vaguely displayed `Blocked · Processing...`, making it impossible to tell whether it was computing or waiting for a reply. The status now directly names the tool blocking it, such as displaying `Blocked · AskQuestion`, clearly indicating that it is waiting for you to answer a question.

items.original: Improved subagent rows above the prompt so a subagent that is blocked waiting on you names the tool it is waiting on, such as `Blocked · AskQuestion`, instead of `Blocked · Processing...`.

title.zh-TW: 終端沙盒限縮外掛真實令牌替換範圍，防止網址反射外洩
title.en: Terminal Sandbox Restricts Real Plugin Token Replacement to Prevent Leakage via URL Reflection

body.zh-TW: 終端機沙盒環境內運行的各類外掛程式，連線授權資訊的防護機制多了一道防線。⟦彷彿持代驗憑條領取機密文件，以前只要任何收件欄填上代號，系統都會換成正式印鑑，容易被回寄外洩；現在只准在指定的授權欄位換上真實印鑑，其他地方一律不予替換。⟧在外掛程式發出請求時，真實的授權令牌（token，用來向第三方服務驗證身分的憑證令牌）現在只會在網路請求的 `Authorization` 標頭中替換代用標記。這能防止惡意指令把代用標記刻意塞在網址或自訂標頭中，避免外部網站將替換後的真實令牌反射回傳而導致憑證外流。
body.en: For various plugins running in the terminal sandbox environment, an extra line of defense has been added to protect connection authorization details. ⟦Imagine claiming confidential documents with a temporary voucher: previously, whenever a code was entered in any recipient field, the system replaced it with an official seal, risking leaks if returned; now the real seal is applied only in the designated authorization field, with replacements prohibited everywhere else.⟧ When a plugin issues a request, real authorization tokens (credentials used to verify identity with third-party services) now replace stand-in markers only in a network request's `Authorization` header. This prevents malicious commands from deliberately stuffing stand-in markers into URLs or custom headers, avoiding credential leaks caused by external websites reflecting back the replaced real tokens.

items.original: Improved how plugin OAuth credentials are protected in the terminal sandbox: a plugin's real token now replaces its stand-in only in a request's `Authorization` header, so a command can no longer get a website to echo the real token back by sending the stand-in in another header or in the URL.

title.zh-TW: 修復 agy acp 工作階段狀態同步，提示取消與表單不再卡死
title.en: Fixed agy acp Session State Sync So Prompt Cancellations and Forms No Longer Hang

body.zh-TW:
透過 ACP 協定與編輯器長時間協同作業時，多項工作階段的中斷與通知問題已獲得修正。⟦有如郵政窗口的叫號系統，以前只要前一位民眾中途抽單，常常導致下一位號碼連帶作廢，舊表單還留在櫃檯；現在中途取消會確實結案，後續叫號與表單關閉都井然有序。⟧以前若在提示執行時關閉、重新載入或恢復工作階段，原本的提示會無限懸掛，現在會正式標示為已取消。手動取消提示也不再連帶中止隨後送出的下一道指令。

通知的傳遞順序也已校正，`session/update` 不會再晚於 `session/prompt` 回應才抵達。權限請求與提問表單若已在其他地方完成回答，或所屬提示已經結束，現在都會自動關閉，不再殘留於畫面上阻礙後續提示。
body.en:
When collaborating with editors over the ACP protocol for extended periods, several session interruption and notification issues have been resolved. ⟦A post office counter queue provides an apt comparison: previously, if the person ahead withdrew their application midway, the next ticket was often invalidated along with it while the old form sat on the counter; now midway cancellations close cleanly, keeping subsequent calling and form dismissals in good order.⟧ Previously, closing, reloading, or resuming a session while a prompt was running left the original prompt hanging indefinitely, but it is now officially marked as `cancelled`. Manually cancelling a prompt also no longer stops the next command sent right after it.

The delivery order of notifications has also been calibrated so that `session/update` no longer arrives after the `session/prompt` reply. Permission requests and question forms now close automatically if they are answered elsewhere or their prompt ends, rather than lingering on screen and blocking subsequent prompts.

items.original: Fixed several `agy acp` session bugs: closing, reloading, or resuming a session while a prompt runs now ends that prompt as `cancelled` instead of leaving it hanging, cancelling a prompt no longer also stops the next prompt sent right after it, `session/update` notifications no longer arrive after the `session/prompt` reply for that prompt, and permission requests and question forms now close when they are answered elsewhere or their prompt ends, instead of blocking later prompts or receiving their answers.

title.zh-TW: 修復 Windows 檔案編輯換行符號錯誤，改善非 ASCII 亂碼與行程釋放
title.en: Fixed Windows File Editing Line Ending Errors, Non-ASCII Garbled Text, and Process Cleanups

body.zh-TW:
Windows 使用者在終端操作時，檔案換行格式、文字編碼與外部工具殘留行程等問題已獲得修復。

針對採用 CRLF 換行符號的檔案，以前編輯常因找不到目標文字（target content not found）而中斷。現在會精準比對換行符號，新增的行數也會沿用檔案原本的換行格式。

當代理執行的指令輸出包含非 ASCII 字元時，以前容易顯示亂碼或直接報錯。現在會自動以 UTF-8 模式（`PYTHONUTF8=1`）執行 Python，並將 PowerShell 的輸出編碼切換為 UTF-8。若你自己已設定 `PYTHONUTF8`，就以你的設定為準。

透過標準輸入運行的 MCP 伺服器（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）停止後，其子行程也不會再殘留背景，解決外掛目錄因檔案被佔用而無法升級的困擾。
body.en:
For Windows users operating in the terminal, issues with file line ending formats, text encoding, and leftover external tool processes have been resolved.

Previously, editing files that use CRLF line endings often aborted because target content could not be found (`target content not found`). Edits now accurately match whichever line endings the file uses, and newly inserted lines preserve the file's original line ending format.

When command output run by the agent contains non-ASCII characters, it previously tended to display garbled text or throw errors. Python is now automatically run in UTF-8 mode (`PYTHONUTF8=1`), and PowerShell's output encoding is switched to UTF-8. If you have set `PYTHONUTF8` yourself, your setting takes precedence.

After stdio MCP servers (Model Context Protocol, an open standard for connecting AI to external tools) stop, their child processes no longer linger in the background. This resolves the issue where plugin directories could not be upgraded because files were in use.

items.original:
Fixed file edits on Windows failing with `target content not found` in files that use CRLF line endings, so edits now match whichever line endings the file uses and the lines they insert keep the file's line endings.
Fixed agent-run commands on Windows failing or returning garbled text when their output contains non-ASCII characters, by running Python in UTF-8 mode (`PYTHONUTF8=1`, unless you have set `PYTHONUTF8` yourself) and switching PowerShell's output encoding to UTF-8.
Fixed stdio MCP servers on Windows leaving their child processes running after the server stops, which could lock plugin folders and make plugin upgrades fail because the files were in use.

title.zh-TW: 企業登入與雲端憑證環境下，外掛市集與指令恢復正常運作
title.en: Plugin Marketplaces and Commands Restored Under Enterprise Login and Cloud Credential Environments

body.zh-TW: 依賴企業模型閘道或應用程式預設憑證（`AGY_ADC_AUTH`）登入的環境下，外掛管理功能現在能正常使用。以前在這類驗證環境下執行 `agy plugin` 指令，會遇到功能不可用且外掛市集完全空白的情況。現在這個問題已經修好，能正常列出外掛市集並執行各項外掛指令。
body.en: In environments that rely on an enterprise model gateway or Application Default Credentials (`AGY_ADC_AUTH`) for sign-in, plugin management features now work normally. Previously, running `agy plugin` commands in these authentication environments resulted in unavailable features and a completely empty plugin marketplace. This issue has now been resolved, properly listing plugin marketplaces and executing various plugin commands.

items.original: Fixed `agy plugin` commands being unavailable, with no plugin marketplaces listed, when you sign in with Application Default Credentials (`AGY_ADC_AUTH`) or through an enterprise model gateway.

title.zh-TW: browser 代理移出對話清單，回歸專屬子代理定位
title.en: browser Agent Removed from Conversation List to Retain Dedicated Subagent Role

body.zh-TW: 開啟新對話挑選要互動的代理時，選單不再顯示專供內部呼叫的工具。以前內建的 `browser` 代理會誤列在對話啟動清單中；但它本質上是設計給主代理在背景調用的子代理。現在它已從一般對話選單中移除，並維持原有的子代理運作方式。
body.en: When starting a new conversation and picking an agent to interact with, the menu no longer displays tools intended strictly for internal calls. Previously, the built-in `browser` agent was mistakenly listed among agents available to start a conversation with; however, it is fundamentally designed as a subagent invoked by the primary agent in the background. It has now been removed from the standard conversation menu while retaining its original operation as a subagent.

items.original: Fixed the built-in `browser` agent being listed among the agents you can start a conversation with, since it is meant to run only as a subagent, which it still does.

title.zh-TW: GNU screen 內複製功能修復，文字精準送入剪貼簿
title.en: Fixed Copying Inside GNU screen So Text Accurately Reaches Clipboard

body.zh-TW: 習慣在 GNU screen 終端環境中操作的使用者，剪貼簿現在能精確接收複製內容。以前在 GNU screen 內使用選取即複製或輸入 `/copy` 時，文字常常無法順利送入剪貼簿，選取較長文字時終端機畫面還會殘留多餘的雜亂字元。現在這個問題已經修好，複製內容會正確進入剪貼簿且畫面維持乾淨。
body.en: For users accustomed to working inside the GNU screen terminal environment, the clipboard now accurately receives copied content. Previously, using copy-on-select or entering `/copy` inside GNU screen often failed to deliver text to the clipboard, and selecting longer text left stray clutter characters on the terminal screen. This issue has now been resolved: copied text properly reaches the clipboard, and the screen stays clean.

items.original: Fixed copy-on-select and `/copy` inside GNU screen, so copied text now reaches your clipboard and long selections no longer leave stray characters in the terminal.

entries: Added `acp` to `agy --help`: `agy acp` runs the CLI as an Agent Client Protocol (ACP) server over stdio, so editors can use it as their agent, with images and embedded file context in prompts, steering a running turn by sending another prompt, `default`, `accept-edits`, and `plan` session modes, `session/resume` restoring a session without replaying its history, each session keeping its own model and thinking level, and Google sign-in from a terminal with `agy acp --login` for editors connected over SSH or without a browser.

Added `--remote-agent` to `agy --help`, which runs the session's conversations on remote agents instead of this machine, where `--project` names a remote project by ID or name and otherwise conversations open in your default remote project; in these sessions `@`-mention completion now searches the remote agent's files, artifacts that can't be shown in the terminal get an `Open in browser` link, the header shows `remote workspace` instead of your local directory, the `/` menu no longer offers skills from this machine, and the Remote tab in `/config` shows the conversation's own permission preset when it has one.

Added local projects to `/projects`, so in a local session you can list your projects with the current one marked, create one from a name and a set of folders given as absolute, `~`, or workspace-relative paths, rename a project or change its folders, and switch to a project, which adds its folders to the workspace and starts a new conversation.

Added sign-in for a partner plugin's MCP servers when you install it from `/plugin`, with a `Connect <plugin>` screen for each server that opens its sign-in page (`Esc` skips), a `⚠ needs sign-in` marker and a `Sign-in:` row for the plugin in the Installed tab, and the third-party developer tools notice for partner plugins at the end of the Discover list, in a plugin's details, and after `agy plugin install` or `/plugin install`.

Added a built-in `${HOME}` variable to plugin `sidecar.json` templates, so a sidecar can name paths under the user's home directory in `workspaceUris` and `accessGrants`, such as `file://${HOME}/worktrees`; a sidecar argument named `HOME` still takes precedence.

Changed headless `-p` runs without `--print-timeout` to wait for background tasks to finish, where they previously stopped them after a hidden 30-minute limit and exited with success; when `--print-timeout` cuts a turn short, the run now exits with code `3`, prints an `AGY_ERROR` line naming the tasks it terminated, and writes a `[agy] print timeout after ...` line to stderr.

Changed `/btw` side questions to be able to call tools, such as reading files or searching, showing each call live in the `/btw` card and a `Called N tools` summary once the answer is done, while any tool call that would ask for permission is denied automatically; this fixes side questions failing with an empty-response error when the model wanted to use a tool.
Changed the `no flickering (altscreen)` option under `Rendering Mode` in `/config` to `full screen (altscreen)`; the saved setting is unchanged.

Improved the error for a stdio MCP server whose command isn't installed, which now says, for example, `"uvx" is not installed or not on PATH, install it or set "command" to its full path` instead of a raw `executable file not found in $PATH` error.

Improved Auto mode's review of commands that would leave the terminal sandbox so it times out and asks less often on safe commands, such as uploads that don't request a review, stopping a job the agent started, installing or removing packages from a registry, and removing files that can be restored from version control.

Fixed `/diff` drawing an empty `↕ ···` fold divider at the top of new files and of edits starting at line 1, where nothing was folded away, and fixed undo in the prompt bringing back a message you had already sent, and undo in `!` shell or `:` search mode bringing back prompt text that `Enter` would then run as a command or search.

Fixed conversations using a `GEMINI_API_KEY` re-sending a prompt forever when the API's safety filter blocks it, which now ends the turn with a content-filter message, and the `pro` and `flash` subagents on that connection running models two generations older instead of Gemini 4 Argon and Gemini 3.8 Flash.

Fixed certain models failing a turn on rate-limit (`429`) and server (`5xx`) errors instead of retrying them, now honoring the server's `Retry-After` header, and fixed plugin auto-upgrades of a plugin installed under a different folder name, such as after a rename, writing to a new folder and retrying on every startup instead of updating the existing folder in place.

title.zh-TW: 支援 ACP 協定，讓編輯器直接調用 agy 擔任代理
title.en: Support ACP so editors can use agy directly as an agent

body.zh-TW: 在慣用的程式碼編輯器中撰寫專案時，若想讓 AI 代理深度融入編輯流程，現在指令列新增了 `agy acp`。⟦好比請一位專屬秘書直接坐進辦公室，以前需要在不同視窗來回複製截圖與檔案，現在編輯器能透過標準輸入輸出直接交代任務。⟧它以 Agent Client Protocol（ACP，讓編輯器連接代理的協定）運作，支援在提問中附帶圖片與檔案內文。你甚至能在回答中途再次送出提示來即時修正方向。每個工作階段都支援獨立的模型與思考深度，並提供 `default`、`accept-edits` 與 `plan` 三種模式。透過 `session/resume` 能直接恢復工作階段而無須重播歷史紀錄。若編輯器運行在沒有瀏覽器的遠端主機，只要執行 `agy acp --login` 即可在終端機完成 Google 登入。
body.en: When writing code in your everyday editor, the command line now adds `agy acp` to weave AI agents deeper into your editing workflow. ⟦Picture hiring a dedicated assistant to sit right inside your office. Where you once had to copy screenshots and files back and forth between windows, the editor now assigns tasks directly over standard input and output.⟧ It runs on the Agent Client Protocol (ACP, a protocol for connecting editors to agents), supporting images and embedded file context in prompts. You can even steer a running turn by sending another prompt mid-answer to adjust course on the fly. Each session supports an independent model and thinking level, providing three modes: `default`, `accept-edits`, and `plan`. Through `session/resume`, you can restore a session directly without replaying its history. If your editor runs on a remote host without a browser, simply running `agy acp --login` lets you complete Google sign-in from the terminal.

items.original: Added `acp` to `agy --help`: `agy acp` runs the CLI as an Agent Client Protocol (ACP) server over stdio, so editors can use it as their agent, with images and embedded file context in prompts, steering a running turn by sending another prompt, `default`, `accept-edits`, and `plan` session modes, `session/resume` restoring a session without replaying its history, each session keeping its own model and thinking level, and Google sign-in from a terminal with `agy acp --login` for editors connected over SSH or without a browser.

title.zh-TW: 新增 `--remote-agent` 參數，將對話交由遠端代理執行
title.en: Add `--remote-agent` flag to run conversations on remote agents

body.zh-TW: 當本機電腦效能吃緊或需要專用運算環境時，你可以把任務分派到雲端主機。⟦如同把手頭工作委派給遠端辦公室的同事，以前所有檔案與流程都綁在自己的桌機上，現在工作改由遠端環境執行。⟧啟動時加上 `--remote-agent` 即可將工作階段的對話移至遠端代理執行，搭配 `--project` 能指定遠端專案名稱或識別碼，未指定時則進入預設專案。在這類工作階段中，鍵入 `@` 補齊會搜尋遠端檔案，終端機無法顯示的產出物會提供 `Open in browser` 連結。介面頂端會改為顯示 `remote workspace`，斜線選單不再提供本機技能，在 `/config` 的 Remote 分頁也會顯示該對話專屬的權限預設。
body.en: When your local machine runs short on power or demands a dedicated computing environment, you can offload tasks to a cloud host. ⟦Think of delegating tasks to a coworker in a remote office. Where every file and process was once tied to your local desktop, the work now runs inside a remote environment.⟧ Adding `--remote-agent` at startup runs the session's conversations on remote agents, while `--project` lets you specify a remote project name or ID, defaulting to your primary project when omitted. In these sessions, `@`-mention completion searches the remote files, and artifacts that cannot be displayed in the terminal provide an `Open in browser` link. The header changes to display `remote workspace`, the slash menu no longer offers local skills, and the Remote tab in `/config` displays the conversation's own permission preset.

items.original: Added `--remote-agent` to `agy --help`, which runs the session's conversations on remote agents instead of this machine, where `--project` names a remote project by ID or name and otherwise conversations open in your default remote project; in these sessions `@`-mention completion now searches the remote agent's files, artifacts that can't be shown in the terminal get an `Open in browser` link, the header shows `remote workspace` instead of your local directory, the `/` menu no longer offers skills from this machine, and the Remote tab in `/config` shows the conversation's own permission preset when it has one.

title.zh-TW: `/projects` 支援本機專案，自由建立並快速切換工作區
title.en: `/projects` adds local project support to create and switch workspaces

body.zh-TW: 在日常開發中頻繁切換不同專案目錄時，反覆尋找路徑往往令人手忙腳亂。⟦跟工作桌上的專案資料夾一樣，以前每次切換任務都要手動重新挑選相關文件，現在只要抽換整份收納夾，所有目錄便整組就位並開啟全新筆記。⟧現在本機工作階段的 `/projects` 指令支援完整的本機專案管理。你能列出專案清單並查看目前項目標記，也能依名稱與一組資料夾建立專案。資料夾路徑支援絕對路徑、波浪號 `~` 或工作區相對路徑。專案隨時可重新命名或修改資料夾；切換專案時，終端機會將其資料夾加入工作區並開啟新對話。
body.en: When constantly switching between project directories during daily development, hunting down paths over and over can easily get chaotic. ⟦Consider how project binders work on an office desk. Where switching tasks once meant hand-picking related documents each time, swapping out the entire binder puts all directories in place at once and opens a brand-new notepad.⟧ The `/projects` command in local sessions now supports full local project management. You can list your projects with the current one marked, or create one from a name and a set of folders. Folder paths accept absolute paths, tildes `~`, or workspace-relative paths. Projects can be renamed or have their folders modified at any time; switching projects adds their folders to the workspace and starts a new conversation.

items.original: Added local projects to `/projects`, so in a local session you can list your projects with the current one marked, create one from a name and a set of folders given as absolute, `~`, or workspace-relative paths, rename a project or change its folders, and switch to a project, which adds its folders to the workspace and starts a new conversation.

title.zh-TW: 外掛與 MCP 設定體驗升級：引導登入、家目錄路徑與清楚的缺少指令提示
title.en: Enhanced plugin and MCP setup: guided sign-in, home directory paths, and clearer missing command errors

body.zh-TW:
在終端機透過外掛連接各類服務時，授權與環境設定現在更直覺。從 `/plugin` 安裝合作夥伴外掛時，若包含 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器，會跳出 `Connect <外掛名稱>` 畫面引導登入，按 `Esc` 可略過。已安裝分頁也會標示 `⚠ needs sign-in`。Discover 清單與安裝後也會顯示第三方開發者工具提醒。

外掛的 `sidecar.json` 範本新增內建 `${HOME}` 變數，方便在 `workspaceUris` 與 `accessGrants` 指定家目錄路徑，同名參數優先採用。

啟動 stdio MCP 伺服器若找不到指令，錯誤訊息會明確提示如 `uvx` 未安裝或不在 PATH 中，提醒安裝或指定完整路徑，不再只丟出找不到執行檔代碼。
body.en:
When connecting to services through plugins in the terminal, authorization and environment configuration are now much more intuitive. Installing a partner plugin from `/plugin` that includes an MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol for connecting AI to external tools) server now brings up a `Connect <plugin>` screen to guide sign-in, which `Esc` can skip. The Installed tab also displays a `⚠ needs sign-in` marker. Third-party developer tools notices now appear at the end of the Discover list and after installation.

Plugin `sidecar.json` templates add a built-in `${HOME}` variable, making it easy to name paths under the home directory in `workspaceUris` and `accessGrants`, while arguments with the same name take precedence.

When launching a stdio MCP server fails because its command is missing, the error message now clearly points out that, for instance, `uvx` is not installed or not on PATH, reminding you to install it or set a full path instead of just reporting a raw missing executable error.

items.original:
Added sign-in for a partner plugin's MCP servers when you install it from `/plugin`, with a `Connect <plugin>` screen for each server that opens its sign-in page (`Esc` skips), a `⚠ needs sign-in` marker and a `Sign-in:` row for the plugin in the Installed tab, and the third-party developer tools notice for partner plugins at the end of the Discover list, in a plugin's details, and after `agy plugin install` or `/plugin install`.
Added a built-in `${HOME}` variable to plugin `sidecar.json` templates, so a sidecar can name paths under the user's home directory in `workspaceUris` and `accessGrants`, such as `file://${HOME}/worktrees`; a sidecar argument named `HOME` still takes precedence.
Improved the error for a stdio MCP server whose command isn't installed, which now says, for example, `"uvx" is not installed or not on PATH, install it or set "command" to its full path` instead of a raw `executable file not found in $PATH` error.

title.zh-TW: 無頭模式完整等待背景工作，逾時明確退出並回報錯誤
title.en: Headless mode waits fully for background tasks, exiting with explicit errors on timeout

body.zh-TW: 編寫自動化腳本以無頭模式（沒有視覺介面的執行模式）透過 `-p` 執行任務時，背景工作不再被暗中掐斷。⟦就像貨運站處理包裹，以前即使後台還有貨物在裝箱，時間一到就當作全部送達並提早收工；現在會確實等待所有背景工作做完才結束，若因倒數截止而中途喊停，也會留下錯誤紀錄並標明未完成的任務。⟧在未指定 `--print-timeout` 的情況下，執行時不再有隱藏的 30 分鐘限制並自動視為成功，而是會持續等待背景工作全部做完。若設定了 `--print-timeout` 且中途切斷，程式會改以退出碼 `3` 結束。它會印出標明終止任務名稱的 `AGY_ERROR` 行，並在標準錯誤輸出寫入 `[agy] print timeout after ...` 紀錄。
body.en: When writing automation scripts to run tasks via `-p` in headless mode (an execution mode without a visual interface), background tasks are no longer quietly cut off. ⟦Imagine a shipping depot processing parcels. Where workers previously called it a day and assumed all deliveries succeeded the moment the clock ran out even with items still being packed in the back, the system now genuinely waits for every background task to wrap up, leaving an error log that flags incomplete tasks if cut short by a countdown.⟧ Without `--print-timeout` specified, runs no longer enforce a hidden 30-minute limit and exit with success, but instead keep waiting for all background tasks to finish. If `--print-timeout` is set and cuts a turn short, the program now exits with code `3`. It prints an `AGY_ERROR` line naming the terminated tasks and writes a `[agy] print timeout after ...` record to standard error.

items.original: Changed headless `-p` runs without `--print-timeout` to wait for background tasks to finish, where they previously stopped them after a hidden 30-minute limit and exited with success; when `--print-timeout` cuts a turn short, the run now exits with code `3`, prints an `AGY_ERROR` line naming the tasks it terminated, and writes a `[agy] print timeout after ...` line to stderr.

title.zh-TW: `/btw` 支援調用工具，查檔搜尋即時顯示並自動略過權限詢問
title.en: `/btw` gains tool calling to search and read files live while auto-denying permission prompts

body.zh-TW: 在長篇對話中想插話向 AI 打聽某個檔案細節時，直接輸入 `/btw` 就能發問而不打斷主線。⟦彷彿在開會中向身旁的速記員咬耳朵，以前他只能憑腦中印象悄聲回答，想翻閱文件就會卡住；現在他能快速查閱檔案再給出答覆，但只要動作需要額外簽核就會主動放棄。⟧現在 `/btw` 插話提問具備調用工具的能力，能直接讀取檔案或搜尋資訊。執行的每個動作都會即時呈現在卡片中，回答完成後會顯示 `Called N tools` 的調用次數摘要。凡是需要向你請求權限的工具操作一律會被自動拒絕。這項修正解決了先前模型想調用工具時，因無法處理而跳出空白回應錯誤的問題。
body.en: When you want to interject and ask the AI about a file detail during a long conversation, entering `/btw` lets you ask without interrupting the main thread. ⟦The experience mirrors whispering to a stenographer beside you in a meeting. Where they previously could only whisper back from memory and froze whenever checking documents was required, they can now quickly consult files before replying, automatically stepping back if an action demands extra sign-off.⟧ Asking side questions with `/btw` now has the ability to call tools, letting it directly read files or search for information. Each executed action appears live inside the card, followed by a `Called N tools` summary once the answer finishes. Any tool operation that would ask you for permission is denied automatically. This fix resolves an issue where the model threw an empty-response error when trying to use tools it could not handle.

items.original: Changed `/btw` side questions to be able to call tools, such as reading files or searching, showing each call live in the `/btw` card and a `Called N tools` summary once the answer is done, while any tool call that would ask for permission is denied automatically; this fixes side questions failing with an empty-response error when the model wanted to use a tool.

title.zh-TW: Auto 模式放寬安全指令審查，減少不必要的授權確認
title.en: Auto mode relaxes review for safe commands to reduce unnecessary confirmations

body.zh-TW: 啟用 Auto 模式讓代理自主執行多步驟任務時，原本頻繁跳出的確認詢問常打斷工作節奏。⟦有如經驗豐富的辦公室警衛，以前即使是倒垃圾或收發已登記的常規包裹，每隔一會兒都要敲門請你簽字；現在面對常態且安全的動作，他給自己設了時限，也少來敲你的門。⟧針對即將離開終端機沙盒的指令，Auto 模式的審查現在會逾時，對安全指令也更少跳出詢問。這些被認可的安全動作包含：未要求審查的上傳作業、終止代理自行啟動的任務、從套件庫安裝或移除套件，以及刪除後續可透過版本控制復原的檔案。這讓你能在確保安全的前提下，更順暢地讓代理獨立完成任務。
body.en: When enabling Auto mode to let the agent independently run multi-step tasks, frequent confirmation prompts used to break your workflow. ⟦An experienced office security guard illustrates the shift well. Where he previously knocked on your door for signatures every few minutes even for taking out trash or logging routine deliveries, he now sets a time limit for standard, safe tasks and knocks far less often.⟧ For commands that would leave the terminal sandbox, Auto mode review now times out and prompts less often for safe commands. These approved safe actions include uploads that do not request review, stopping tasks the agent started itself, installing or removing packages from a registry, and deleting files that can later be restored through version control. This lets you allow the agent to complete tasks independently and smoothly while preserving safety.

items.original: Improved Auto mode's review of commands that would leave the terminal sandbox so it times out and asks less often on safe commands, such as uploads that don't request a review, stopping a job the agent started, installing or removing packages from a registry, and removing files that can be restored from version control.

title.zh-TW: 終端機介面調整：選單選項更名為全螢幕，修復 diff 摺疊線與復原鍵錯誤
title.en: Terminal UI adjustments: full screen menu rename, diff fold divider fixes, and undo key fixes

body.zh-TW:
在終端機檢視檔案差異或切換輸入模式時，幾處顯示與按鍵操作細節獲得了修正。在 `/config` 的 `Rendering Mode` 中，原本名為 `no flickering (altscreen)` 的選項已更名為 `full screen (altscreen)`，已儲存設定維持不變。

修復 `/diff` 在新檔案或從第 1 行修改時，會在最上方繪製多餘且無摺疊內容的 `↕ ···` 空白摺疊線。另外修復在輸入框按復原鍵會喚回已送出訊息，以及在 `!` Shell 或 `:` 搜尋模式按復原會叫回文字並在按 `Enter` 後誤跑指令或搜尋的問題。⟦就像在通訊軟體打草稿，按復原鍵只會抹掉剛打的字，絕不會把你五分鐘前早就發出去的舊訊息又撈回來重傳。⟧
body.en:
When inspecting file differences or switching input modes in the terminal, several display and keystroke details have been refined. In `/config` under `Rendering Mode`, the previous `no flickering (altscreen)` option has been renamed. It is now called `full screen (altscreen)`, while saved settings remain unchanged.

Fixed `/diff` drawing an empty `↕ ···` fold divider at the top of new files and edits starting at line 1, where nothing was folded away. In addition, fixed pressing undo in the prompt bringing back already-sent messages, as well as undo in `!` Shell or `:` search mode restoring text that `Enter` would then accidentally run as a command or search. ⟦Drafting a message in a chat app follows the same principle: pressing undo should only erase the words you just typed, never resurrecting an old message you already sent five minutes ago to transmit again.⟧

items.original:
Changed the `no flickering (altscreen)` option under `Rendering Mode` in `/config` to `full screen (altscreen)`; the saved setting is unchanged.
Fixed `/diff` drawing an empty `↕ ···` fold divider at the top of new files and of edits starting at line 1, where nothing was folded away, and fixed undo in the prompt bringing back a message you had already sent, and undo in `!` shell or `:` search mode bringing back prompt text that `Enter` would then run as a command or search.

title.zh-TW: 修復模型連線與外掛更新問題：安全過濾死循環、錯誤重試與更新路徑
title.en: Fix model connection and plugin update bugs: safety filter loops, error retries, and upgrade paths

body.zh-TW:
使用外部金鑰連接模型或讓外掛自動升級時，先前幾處例外處理的缺陷已獲得修正。使用 `GEMINI_API_KEY` 連線時，若觸發 API 安全過濾機制，過去會陷入無限重送提示的死循環，現在會顯示內容過濾訊息並結束該輪對話；該連線下的 `pro` 與 `flash` 子代理先前誤用落後兩代的老模型，現已修正為 Gemini 4 Argon 與 Gemini 3.8 Flash。

特定模型遇到速率限制（`429`）與伺服器 `5xx` 錯誤時不再直接失敗，現在會依據伺服器的 `Retry-After` 標頭自動重試。

若外掛安裝於不同名稱的資料夾（例如重新命名後），過去每次啟動都會寫入新目錄並重試更新，現在已修正為在現有資料夾就地更新。⟦跟整修老房子一樣，施工隊會認準原址就地翻新，不再因為招牌換了就每次都跑到空地另外蓋一間新屋。⟧
body.en:
When connecting to models with external keys or letting plugins upgrade automatically, several previous exception-handling flaws have been resolved. When connecting with a `GEMINI_API_KEY`, triggering API safety filters previously caused an endless loop of re-sending prompts. The turn now ends with a content-filter message. On that same connection, `pro` and `flash` subagents previously ran models two generations older, which has now been corrected to Gemini 4 Argon and Gemini 3.8 Flash.

Instead of failing outright on rate-limit (`429`) and server `5xx` errors, certain models now retry automatically based on the server's `Retry-After` header.

For plugins installed under a different folder name, such as after a rename, startup previously wrote to a new directory and retried upgrading every time. This has now been fixed to update the existing folder in place. ⟦Renovating an old house works the same way. The construction crew commits to renovating right on the original site, rather than running off to an empty lot to build an entirely new house every time the sign changes.⟧

items.original:
Fixed conversations using a `GEMINI_API_KEY` re-sending a prompt forever when the API's safety filter blocks it, which now ends the turn with a content-filter message, and the `pro` and `flash` subagents on that connection running models two generations older instead of Gemini 4 Argon and Gemini 3.8 Flash.
Fixed certain models failing a turn on rate-limit (`429`) and server (`5xx`) errors instead of retrying them, now honoring the server's `Retry-After` header, and fixed plugin auto-upgrades of a plugin installed under a different folder name, such as after a rename, writing to a new folder and retrying on every startup instead of updating the existing folder in place.

entries: Added `"optional": true` for API key providers in a plugin's `auth.json`, for services that work without a key but raise rate limits with one: when you haven't set the key, the plugin's commands now see the variable as unset and make unauthenticated requests at the free rate limit, instead of failing with `401` errors or asking you to sign in.

Fixed Markdown tables in long streaming replies leaving misaligned borders and repeated text in your terminal scrollback: a table's rows now stay in the live view until the table is complete, so they reach scrollback with their final column widths.

title.zh-TW: 外掛的 API 金鑰可以設成選填
title.en: Plugin API Keys Can Now Be Optional

body.zh-TW:
你剛裝好一個串接網路服務的外掛，想先試試基本功能，手邊卻還沒申請帳號。現在外掛作者可以在外掛的 `auth.json` 裡，把某個 API 金鑰（向線上服務證明身分的存取密碼）提供者標記成選填，做法是在那一項加上 `"optional": true`。它適用於不用金鑰也能用、但附上金鑰能提高限流（服務限制單位時間內請求次數的機制）門檻的服務。

標成選填後，你還沒設定金鑰時，外掛指令會把存放金鑰的那個變數當成未設定，直接以免費的限流額度發出未驗證請求。以前同樣的情況會出現 `401` 錯誤，或跳出要你登入的畫面。⟦跟逛公立展覽館一樣，以前入口一律要看會員證，沒帶就被擋在門外；現在沒登記的訪客也能領普通號碼牌入場，出示會員卡則能換到更多參觀名額。⟧
body.en:
You've just installed a plugin that connects to an online service and want to try the basics, but you haven't signed up for an account yet. Plugin authors can now mark an API key (an access password that proves your identity to an online service) provider as optional in the plugin's `auth.json` by adding `"optional": true` to that entry. It is meant for services that work without a key but raise rate limits (caps on how many requests you can send per unit of time) when you have one.

Once a key is optional and you haven't set it, the plugin's commands see the variable holding the key as unset and make unauthenticated requests at the free rate limit. Before, the same situation failed with `401` errors or asked you to sign in. ⟦Think of a public exhibition hall: the entrance used to demand a membership card and turned away anyone without one; now walk-in visitors can take a regular ticket and enter, while members who show their card get a larger visiting allowance.⟧

items.original: Added `"optional": true` for API key providers in a plugin's `auth.json`, for services that work without a key but raise rate limits with one: when you haven't set the key, the plugin's commands now see the variable as unset and make unauthenticated requests at the free rate limit, instead of failing with `401` errors or asking you to sign in.

title.zh-TW: 串流中的長表格完成後才進捲動紀錄，邊框不再歪斜
title.en: Streamed Tables Now Reach Scrollback Only When Complete

body.zh-TW: 在終端機收到很長的回覆時，如果裡面有 Markdown 表格，往上翻常會看到版面亂掉。以前在串流（模型一邊生成一邊即時顯示）輸出時，表格列太早被推進捲動紀錄，也就是往上翻看得到的舊畫面，結果留下歪斜的邊框和重複的文字。現在表格各列會先留在即時畫面，等整張表格完成，才用最終欄寬推進捲動紀錄，往上翻就不會再看到錯位。
body.en: When you get a long reply in the terminal that contains a Markdown table, scrolling up often showed a broken layout. Before, while streaming (showing output in real time as the model generates it), table rows reached your terminal scrollback too early, leaving misaligned borders and repeated text. Now a table's rows stay in the live view until the table is complete, then reach scrollback with their final column widths, so scrolling up no longer shows the misalignment.

items.original: Fixed Markdown tables in long streaming replies leaving misaligned borders and repeated text in your terminal scrollback: a table's rows now stay in the live view until the table is complete, so they reach scrollback with their final column widths.

entries: Added a billing model choice after you sign in with Google Cloud, so you can pick either a Gemini subscription or Pay As You Go.

Added `terminationBehavior` to `PreInvocation` hooks: returning `"terminate"` stops the turn before the model is called, for example to block a prompt that contains sensitive data, and hooks can now inject an `errorMessage` whose `userMessage` is shown to you without being sent to the model, which also makes a `-p` run exit with a non-zero code.

Added a `finished_reason` field to the result of `--output-format json` and `stream-json` runs that says why a turn ended early, `print_timeout` when `--print-timeout` expired and the response is partial, `interrupted` when the run was canceled such as with `Ctrl+C`, or `error` for any other failure, so scripts can tell a cut-off answer from a complete one; the field is omitted when the turn finishes normally.

Improved the `/plugin` Discover tab for long shelves: each shelf now shows its first 6 plugins followed by a `⋯ N more — enter to show` row, `Ctrl+E` expands or collapses the shelf under the cursor, and `[` and `]` jump to the previous or next shelf.

Fixed `agy plugin import claude` printing `No claude extensions found.` for plugins installed from a Claude Code marketplace: it now reads Claude Code's list of installed plugins, skipping plugins disabled in Claude Code's settings and plugins installed for a single project only, and imported plugins now keep their remote MCP servers (`"type": "http"` with `url` and `headers`) and servers from `.mcp.json` files without an `mcpServers` wrapper, expand `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` to the installed plugin's directory, and list servers that can't be converted, such as ones using the legacy SSE transport, with a warning instead of reporting them as installed.

title.zh-TW: Google Cloud 登入支援自選計費模式，可挑 Gemini 訂閱制或隨用隨付
title.en: Google Cloud sign-in now supports selecting a billing model, allowing a choice between a Gemini subscription or Pay As You Go

body.zh-TW: 如果你習慣使用 Google Cloud 帳號登入工具來處理專案，現在帳號綁定的付款機制多了清楚的選擇步驟。⟦跟到電信門市挑選門號資費一樣，以前完成登記後無法自選計費管道，現在你能依使用習慣挑選固定月租，或是用多少算多少的預付扣額。⟧以往透過 Google Cloud 登入時，無法在登入流程中直接決定開銷型態。現在只要完成 Google Cloud 登入驗證，畫面便會跳出計費模式選項。你可以直接勾選 Gemini 訂閱制（Gemini subscription）。如果偏好用多少算多少，也能挑選隨用隨付（Pay As You Go，按實際用量付費）方案。這讓你在登入當下就能敲定計費規則，避免扣款方式與預算規劃產生出入。
body.en: If you are used to signing into tools with a Google Cloud account to handle projects, the payment mechanism tied to your account now includes a clear selection step. ⟦Much like choosing a mobile plan at a telecom store, where you could not choose your billing channel after registering before, you can now pick a fixed monthly rate or pay-as-you-go prepaid credits based on your usage habits.⟧ Previously when signing in through Google Cloud, you could not decide your expense type directly in the sign-in flow. Now once Google Cloud sign-in authentication is complete, a billing model option appears on screen. You can directly select a Gemini subscription. If you prefer to pay for what you use, you can also select the Pay As You Go (paying only for what you use) plan. This lets you settle the billing rules right when signing in, preventing discrepancies between charges and budget plans.

items.original: Added a billing model choice after you sign in with Google Cloud, so you can pick either a Gemini subscription or Pay As You Go.

title.zh-TW: PreInvocation 掛鉤支援終止對話，攔截提示詞並回傳警示
title.en: PreInvocation hooks now support terminating turns to block prompts and return alerts

body.zh-TW: 當你在工具中設定自動檢查機制來保護機密時，現在能在送出請求的最前線精準把關。⟦如同機場託運安檢的掃描輸送帶，以前發現行李夾帶違禁品往往難以在中途攔截，現在能在送進貨艙前立刻截停，並向旅客出示退件通知單。⟧在 `PreInvocation` 掛鉤（hook，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）中，現在新增了 `terminationBehavior` 設定項。只要掛鉤回傳 `"terminate"`，就能在呼叫模型之前中止當前對話，例如及時攔截包含機敏資料的提示詞。掛鉤還能同時注入 `errorMessage` 物件，當中的 `userMessage` 訊息只會直接顯示在你的終端機畫面上，絕不會傳送給模型。若是透過 `-p` 參數執行的非互動流程，遇到終止時也會以非零狀態碼結束退出。
body.en: When configuring automated checks in the tool to protect confidential data, you can now maintain precise guardrails at the very front line of outgoing requests. ⟦Think of an airport baggage screening conveyor belt: whereas luggage containing contraband was previously hard to intercept midway, it can now be halted immediately before entering the cargo hold, presenting a return notice to the passenger.⟧ In `PreInvocation` hooks (small programs triggered by specific events), a new `terminationBehavior` setting has been added. As long as the hook returns `"terminate"`, it can stop the current turn before the model is called, such as blocking a prompt that contains sensitive data in time. The hook can also inject an `errorMessage` object at the same time, whose `userMessage` is shown directly on your terminal screen and is never sent to the model. If running a non-interactive flow via the `-p` flag, encountering a termination will also exit with a non-zero status code.

items.original: Added `terminationBehavior` to `PreInvocation` hooks: returning `"terminate"` stops the turn before the model is called, for example to block a prompt that contains sensitive data, and hooks can now inject an `errorMessage` whose `userMessage` is shown to you without being sent to the model, which also makes a `-p` run exit with a non-zero code.

title.zh-TW: JSON 輸出新增 finished_reason，精確標記提早中斷原因
title.en: JSON output adds finished_reason to accurately indicate why a turn ended early

body.zh-TW: 當你撰寫自動化腳本呼叫工具時，程式往往需要判斷回傳內容究竟有沒有講完。⟦好比自動櫃員機列印的明細表，以前交易中斷只能看著螢幕發愣，現在明細會印出逾時未領、手動取消還是連線異常，順利完成時則不留多餘標註。⟧現在使用 `--output-format json` 或 `stream-json` 格式輸出時，回傳結果新增了 `finished_reason` 欄位。如果執行過程因為 `--print-timeout` 時間耗盡而只產生部分回覆，該欄位會標示為 `print_timeout`。若因使用者按下 `Ctrl+C` 等操作取消執行，則會記錄為 `interrupted`。遭遇其他執行失敗時，會代入 `error`。這讓外部腳本能立刻釐清回答是被截斷還是完整輸出，而當對話正常結束時，輸出結果會直接省略此欄位。
body.en: When writing automated scripts to call the tool, programs often need to determine whether the returned content has finished speaking. ⟦An ATM receipt once left users staring at the screen during an interrupted transaction, but now prints whether it timed out, was manually canceled, or suffered a connection anomaly, leaving no extra notes when completed smoothly.⟧ Now when outputting with `--output-format json` or `stream-json`, a `finished_reason` field has been added to the returned results. If the execution produces only a partial response because `--print-timeout` expired, this field is marked as `print_timeout`. If the execution is canceled by user actions such as pressing `Ctrl+C`, it is recorded as `interrupted`. When encountering other execution failures, it is populated with `error`. This allows external scripts to immediately clarify whether an answer was cut off or output completely, while the field is omitted directly when the turn finishes normally.

items.original: Added a `finished_reason` field to the result of `--output-format json` and `stream-json` runs that says why a turn ended early, `print_timeout` when `--print-timeout` expired and the response is partial, `interrupted` when the run was canceled such as with `Ctrl+C`, or `error` for any other failure, so scripts can tell a cut-off answer from a complete one; the field is omitted when the turn finishes normally.

title.zh-TW: 外掛探索分頁支援分層收合，並修復 Claude 外掛匯入與 MCP 轉換
title.en: The plugin Discover tab supports collapsible shelves, fixing Claude plugin imports and MCP conversions

body.zh-TW:
當你想在工具中尋找或搬移外掛時，介面排版與轉換相容性現在都有了改善。⟦就像整理零件貨架，以前排面過長難以翻閱、外來套件也常因規格不符碰壁，現在分層收合清楚，規格也自動對齊。⟧在 `/plugin` 的 Discover 分頁中，每層架子只列出前 6 個外掛與展開列，並新增快捷操作：

```text
# 快速鍵操作
Ctrl+E                  # 展開或收合游標處架子
[ / ]                   # 跳至上一個或下一個架子

# 外掛匯入與 MCP 轉換
"type": "http"          # 保留含 url 與 headers 的遠端伺服器
.mcp.json               # 支援未含 mcpServers 包裹層的設定
${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}   # 自動展開為外掛安裝目錄
```

執行 `agy plugin import claude` 匯入 Claude Code 市集外掛時，不再誤報找不到擴充。現在會讀取安裝清單，並略過停用或單一專案專用的外掛。匯入時會保留遠端 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器與 `.mcp.json` 設定，若遇到舊版 SSE 等無法轉換的伺服器，會顯示警告而非回報為已安裝。
body.en:
When you want to search for or migrate plugins in the tool, interface layouts and conversion compatibility are now improved. ⟦Picture organizing a parts shelf: whereas excessively long displays were once cumbersome to browse and external packages frequently hit walls over mismatched specifications, shelves now collapse clearly into layers while specifications align automatically.⟧ In the Discover tab of `/plugin`, each shelf lists only its first 6 plugins along with an expand row, and introduces shortcut operations:

```text
# Shortcut operations
Ctrl+E                  # Expand or collapse the shelf under the cursor
[ / ]                   # Jump to the previous or next shelf

# Plugin import and MCP conversion
"type": "http"          # Retain remote servers with url and headers
.mcp.json               # Support configurations without an mcpServers wrapper
${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}   # Automatically expand to the plugin installation directory
```

When running `agy plugin import claude` to import Claude Code marketplace plugins, it no longer mistakenly reports that no extensions were found. It now reads the installation list, skipping disabled plugins or those dedicated to a single project. During import, remote MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol for connecting AI to external tools) servers and `.mcp.json` configurations are retained. If it encounters servers that cannot be converted, such as legacy SSE, it displays a warning instead of reporting them as installed.

items.original:
Improved the `/plugin` Discover tab for long shelves: each shelf now shows its first 6 plugins followed by a `⋯ N more — enter to show` row, `Ctrl+E` expands or collapses the shelf under the cursor, and `[` and `]` jump to the previous or next shelf.
Fixed `agy plugin import claude` printing `No claude extensions found.` for plugins installed from a Claude Code marketplace: it now reads Claude Code's list of installed plugins, skipping plugins disabled in Claude Code's settings and plugins installed for a single project only, and imported plugins now keep their remote MCP servers (`"type": "http"` with `url` and `headers`) and servers from `.mcp.json` files without an `mcpServers` wrapper, expand `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` to the installed plugin's directory, and list servers that can't be converted, such as ones using the legacy SSE transport, with a warning instead of reporting them as installed.

entries: Improved streaming of agent replies: lines that scroll off the top of the screen are now scrolled into your terminal's scrollback instead of repainting the whole screen, and text wrapping writes whole runs of text at a time, so streaming writes about 70% fewer bytes to the terminal and stays much smoother over slow SSH connections.

Improved memory use shortly after startup: the CLI now returns about 100 MB of memory left over from startup to the operating system 15 seconds after the interactive UI opens; print and headless modes are unaffected.

Improved the after-compaction size shown in the compaction marker and in `/context` to also count what the summary carries into the next prompt, such as your earlier requests and artifact, subagent, and running-task snapshots, so it is closer to the real size; the `(N summary)` label still shows the summary alone.

Fixed subagents losing the task their parent agent gave them, and the parent's ID, after their context was compacted, including with `/compact`; a subagent's summary now keeps the parent agent's 10 most recent messages.

Fixed conversations with many or large images, such as screenshots or pasted images, being rejected for exceeding the model's request size limit: images are now capped at 2000 pixels per side and large PNGs are sent as JPEGs when that is much smaller, and an image saved as JPEG but labeled PNG, such as a pasted image or browser screenshot, is no longer rejected for a mismatched type.

Fixed the `/browser` subagent not receiving the current page's snapshot when the selected page belongs to an isolated browser context, such as a page opened with `isolatedContext` or attached from an Incognito window.

title.zh-TW: 串流輸出改用終端回捲，連線傳輸減少約七成位元組
title.en: Streaming output switches to terminal scrollback, cutting transmitted bytes by about 70%

body.zh-TW: 透過遠端連線指揮工具工作時，終端機逐字跑出長篇回覆常會遇到畫面卡頓與延遲。⟦如同傳真機連續吐出紙張，新內容推進時直接讓舊頁面順著捲紙滾入底槽，不必每印一行就把整面白板擦掉重描。⟧以往串流輸出在文字超出螢幕頂端時，總會重新繪製整個終端機畫面。現在超出螢幕頂部的行數會直接滾入終端機的回捲緩衝區（scrollback，往上滾動查看歷史紀錄的區域）。文字折行也改為一次寫入整串連續文字，讓寫入終端機的傳輸量減少約 70% 位元組。即使透過慢速的 SSH 連線（Secure Shell，加密遠端連線協定）操作，接收長篇回覆也能維持滑順流暢。
body.en: When directing tools over a remote connection, watching a terminal print long replies word by word often runs into screen stutter and latency. ⟦Like a fax machine feeding paper continuously, incoming content lets older pages roll into the bottom tray along the paper feed instead of erasing and redrawing an entire whiteboard for every printed line.⟧ Previously, streaming output always repainted the entire terminal screen whenever text went past the top of the screen. Now, lines that scroll off the top of the screen scroll directly into the terminal's scrollback (an area for scrolling up to view history). Text wrapping also switches to writing whole runs of continuous text at a time, cutting the bytes written to the terminal by about 70%. Even when operating over a slow SSH connection (Secure Shell, an encrypted remote connection protocol), receiving long replies stays smooth and fluid.

items.original: Improved streaming of agent replies: lines that scroll off the top of the screen are now scrolled into your terminal's scrollback instead of repainting the whole screen, and text wrapping writes whole runs of text at a time, so streaming writes about 70% fewer bytes to the terminal and stays much smoother over slow SSH connections.

title.zh-TW: 互動介面開啟十五秒後，自動歸還啟動殘留記憶體
title.en: Startup memory returned automatically fifteen seconds after interactive UI opens

body.zh-TW: 開啟終端機工具並常駐在背景時，程式佔用的硬體資源往往會影響電腦的整體流暢度。⟦跟大型演出進場一樣，工作人員在開演前搬進大量裝箱工具，等到演出開始十五秒後，便把卸貨的推車撤出場館，將走道空間交還給大樓。⟧以往命令列介面在完成初始化後，載入過程所消耗的暫存記憶體會一直被工具佔用。現在只要互動式介面開啟 15 秒，工具就會主動把啟動階段殘留的約 100 MB 記憶體歸還給作業系統。如果你是透過列印模式，或是無頭模式（headless，沒有終端機視窗的執行模式）執行一次性指令，運作行為則不受影響。
body.en: When opening a terminal tool and keeping it running in the background, the hardware resources consumed by the program often affect overall system responsiveness. ⟦In a large stage production setup, stagehands haul in stacks of boxed tools before showtime, and fifteen seconds after the performance begins, they wheel the unloading carts out of the venue to return aisle space to the building.⟧ Previously, after the command line interface finished initialization, the temporary memory consumed during the loading process remained occupied by the tool. Now, fifteen seconds after the interactive UI opens, the tool actively returns about 100 MB of memory left over from the startup phase to the operating system. If you run one-off commands through print mode or headless mode (an execution mode without a terminal window), operation remains unaffected.

items.original: Improved memory use shortly after startup: the CLI now returns about 100 MB of memory left over from startup to the operating system 15 seconds after the interactive UI opens; print and headless modes are unaffected.

title.zh-TW: 壓縮對話納入附加快照估算，子代理摘要保留上層任務
title.en: Compacted conversations count attached snapshots, and subagent summaries preserve parent tasks

body.zh-TW: 想要在長對話中執行 `/compact` 壓縮歷史紀錄，或是交由子代理分頭處理複雜專案，精簡上下文之餘更要確保資訊不漏失。⟦好比專案交接整理摘要，以前只計算備忘錄字數而漏算隨附圖表，助理甚至在精簡時忘記委託人編號；現在清單如實計入所有附件重量，並完整保留指派人交付的任務與最新叮嚀。⟧以前壓縮標記與 `/context` 顯示的壓縮後數值，只計算了純摘要本身。現在統計會納入摘要帶入下一輪提示的所有內容，包含早先的請求，以及產出物、子代理與執行中任務的快照，讓數值更貼近真實大小；標籤 `(N summary)` 則維持單獨標示純摘要。過去子代理在上下文經過壓縮後（包含使用 `/compact`），容易遺失上層代理指派的任務與上層 ID。現在子代理的摘要會保留原任務與上層識別碼，並留存上層代理最近 10 則訊息。
body.en: When running `/compact` to compress history in long conversations or handing off complex projects to subagents, trimming context must never come at the cost of losing information. ⟦Picture a project handover briefing. Previously, staff counted only the memo words while overlooking attached diagrams, and the assistant even dropped the client ID when condensing notes. Now the manifest faithfully tallies the weight of all attachments while fully preserving the assigner's delegated task and latest reminders.⟧ Previously, the after-compaction size shown in the compaction marker and in `/context` counted only the pure summary itself. Now the tally includes everything the summary carries into the next prompt, such as your earlier requests along with artifact, subagent, and running-task snapshots, bringing the figure closer to the real size. The `(N summary)` label continues to show the summary alone. In the past, subagents often lost the task assigned by their parent agent and the parent ID after their context was compacted (including when using `/compact`). A subagent's summary now preserves the original task and parent ID, while keeping the parent agent's 10 most recent messages.

items.original:
Improved the after-compaction size shown in the compaction marker and in `/context` to also count what the summary carries into the next prompt, such as your earlier requests and artifact, subagent, and running-task snapshots, so it is closer to the real size; the `(N summary)` label still shows the summary alone.
Fixed subagents losing the task their parent agent gave them, and the parent's ID, after their context was compacted, including with `/compact`; a subagent's summary now keeps the parent agent's 10 most recent messages.

title.zh-TW: 對話圖檔限制兩千像素並自動轉檔，避免超出請求上限
title.en: Conversation images capped at 2000 pixels and converted automatically to avoid request limits

body.zh-TW: 在對話中貼上多張高解析度截圖或照片時，送出請求常會因為資料量過大而遭到模型直接拒絕。⟦就像郵局寄送包裹，以前包裹只要尺寸超標或貼錯標籤就會直接退件；現在收件窗口會先幫超大包裹修剪體積，在不影響內容下把厚重包裝換成輕便紙袋，遇到標籤貼錯的信件也主動辨識放行。⟧現在輸入對話的圖片每邊最長會被限制在 2000 像素以內。體積較大的 PNG 圖片若轉為 JPEG 能明顯縮減大小，便會自動改以 JPEG 格式傳送。針對剪貼簿貼上的圖片或瀏覽器截圖，如果檔案本體是 JPEG 卻被標記成 PNG，工具也不會再因為型別不一致而拒絕請求。
body.en: When pasting multiple high-resolution screenshots or photos into a conversation, sending requests often led to outright rejection by the model due to excessive payload size. ⟦At a postal parcel counter, packages exceeding dimensions or bearing mismatched labels were once returned immediately. Now, counter staff trim down oversized parcels first, swapping heavy packaging for lightweight mailers without altering the contents, and actively identify mislabeled letters to let them pass.⟧ Images entered into conversations are now capped at 2000 pixels per side. Large PNG images that become significantly smaller when converted to JPEG are now automatically sent in JPEG format. For images pasted from the clipboard or browser screenshots where the file is actually a JPEG but labeled PNG, the tool no longer rejects requests because of a mismatched type.

items.original: Fixed conversations with many or large images, such as screenshots or pasted images, being rejected for exceeding the model's request size limit: images are now capped at 2000 pixels per side and large PNGs are sent as JPEGs when that is much smaller, and an image saved as JPEG but labeled PNG, such as a pasted image or browser screenshot, is no longer rejected for a mismatched type.

title.zh-TW: 修復瀏覽器子代理在無痕與隔離視窗下遺漏頁面快照
title.en: Fixed browser subagent missing page snapshots in Incognito and isolated contexts

body.zh-TW: 如果請 `/browser` 子代理操作特定網頁，遇到以 `isolatedContext` 開啟的頁面或附加自無痕視窗（Incognito）等隔離環境，以前子代理會抓不到當前頁面的快照。這個問題已經修好，子代理現在能正常接收該頁面的快照資訊。
body.en: When asking the `/browser` subagent to operate on a specific page that belongs to an isolated environment, such as a page opened with `isolatedContext` or attached from an Incognito window, the subagent previously failed to capture snapshots of the current page. This issue has been fixed, and the subagent now receives the page's snapshot information normally.

items.original: Fixed the `/browser` subagent not receiving the current page's snapshot when the selected page belongs to an isolated browser context, such as a page opened with `isolatedContext` or attached from an Incognito window.
